components.name: proposition
values: scfoundation is a large-scale foundation model with 100 million parameters pretrained on over 50 million human single-cell transcriptomic profiles covering about 20 000 genes and achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse downstream tasks including gene expression enhancement drug response prediction perturbation prediction and cell type annotation.

components.name: proposition
values: scfoundation achieved the highest macro f1 score on cell type annotation tasks zheng68k and tm datasets with particular improvements in rare cell types.

components.name: proposition
values: scfoundation-based model for drug response prediction achieved high pearson and spearman correlations with higher clustering scores ch sil compared to gene expression baseline and enabled better transfer between bulk and single-cell data.

components.name: proposition
values: scfoundation gene context embeddings improve gears perturbation prediction performance reducing mse and better capturing top differential expression magnitude.

components.name: proposition
values: scfoundation outperformed imputation methods magic saver scimpute and scvi in clustering metrics nmi ari and sil on a human pancreatic islet dataset when t/s fold change was greater than 1.

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation outperformed baseline and scimpute in all metrics when t=s fold change 1 and surpassed all methods at higher t/s folds plateau at t/s >=3.5.

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation reduced mae and mre by half from downsampled data when downsampling rate below 10%.

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation-based drug response prediction achieved pearson correlation 0.93 and spearman correlation 0.87 for all cancer types for drug wz-1-84 on low-grade gliomas pearson 0.94 spearman 0.95.

components.name: observation
values: higher ch and sil scores for scfoundation embeddings compared to gene expression baseline in drug sensitivity clustering.

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation outperformed baseline and scimpute in sil.

components.name: observation
values: power-law decline in validation loss correlating with increased model size and computation 100m-parameter scfoundation surpassed all other models tested.

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation outperformed baseline and scimpute in ari at t=s and all t/s folds.

components.name: metric
values: percent of top 20 de genes in 45-55% interval

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation-based gears achieved higher percentage of top 20 de genes falling within 45-55% quantile of true distribution compared to baseline on norman and dixit datasets.

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation achieved the highest macro f1 on both zheng68k and tm datasets compared to celltypist scbert scanvi actinn scanpy and singlecellnet.

components.name: observation
values: scfoundation-based gears reduced mse compared to baseline gears on both dixit et al. and norman et al. datasets across unseen perturbation categories.

components.name: method
values: rda pretraining task | for each cell a hierarchical bayesian downsampling strategy generates a low total counts variant. normalize and log-transform both raw and input vectors. define t target total counts of raw sample and s source total counts of input sample . randomly mask 30% of both zero and nonzero genes. model predicts raw expression at masked positions using masked input plus t and s indicators. loss is regression mse on masked positions.

xtrimogene architecture | scalable transformer-based model with embedding module and asymmetric encoder-decoder structure. embedding module converts continuous gene expression scalars into learnable high-dimensional vectors. encoder processes only nonzero and nonmasked gene embeddings plus t and s tokens. decoder combines encoder output with mask and zero embeddings. final mlp layer projects decoder output to expression values.

values: percent of top 20 de genes in 45-55% interval

components.name: task
values: develop scfoundation a 100-million-parameter model covering 19 264 genes pretrained on over 50 million human scrna-seq profiles using the xtrimogene architecture and rda pretraining task.
